cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll coordinate our exchange. Half an hour helping you move gets me two hours of shed painting Saturday morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Morning's my only lie-in. I can come after lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd miss cricket. Three hours for the afternoon slot. Unless you've a way to keep both our plans intact?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hire a painter. But the sofa needs carrying up three flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That works with my system. Two painter-hours for loading, one for the stairs. You choose the painter and day; I'll fit the shed around them. Cricket stays mine.
